description_under_test: Use when reviewing a diff, pull request, or staged changes in this repo. Triggers on "review", "code review", "check my PR"...
notes: 16 trigger cases (8 positive / 8 negative) + 4 result-quality cases. Negatives deliberately include neighbour skills (gen-tests, scaffold-service) and the 'review my prose' near-miss.

trigger_cases.prompt: review my staged changes before I push
can you do a code review on this PR?
check my diff for security issues
look at my changes in src/auth and tell me what's wrong
is this PR ready to merge? review it against our standards
review the login handler I just wrote for IDOR and injection
go over my staged commit and flag any blockers
review my changes to the orders service
scaffold a new payments service in our standard layout
run lint and tests and give me a PR description
review my blog post draft about our new API
review my resume for this job application
explain how JWT refresh tokens work

assertions.check: output contains Blocker, Should-fix and Nit sections
every finding includes a file:line reference
flags the == password comparison as a security blocker
output ends with an explicit merge verdict
output never approves without stating findings or that the change is clean
flags the interpolated SQL string and suggests parameterization
notes business logic / data access in the wrong layer
does NOT fabricate blockers for clean, conventional code
states the change passes the checklist and why
reports there is nothing to review and stops, with no invented findings
